column1: # Stage S6 P1 — the spatial indexes, the prefab catalogue and the world chunks leave the map engine
# for the crates spatial_indexes, prefab_catalog and world_chunks. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# the point grid, the picks and the zoom-level clusters become spatial_indexes' point indexes
# the triangle BVH, its build core, its sidecar format, its surface kinds and the slab test become
# spatial_indexes' bounding volume hierarchy; the legacy `bvh` module root stays as the shim
# the prefab rows and their archive form, the footprint lookups, the render classes, the prefab
# tables and the payload decoding become prefab_catalog
# the chunk JSON and TBDC decoders and the terrain manifest parse become world_chunks
